'''Loom Carplin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Travia Chan/Legends|Travia Chan's]] [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Loom Carplin was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]]. A founding member of the [[Mantooine Liberators]], Carplin was the highest-ranking survivor of the resistance group after it was [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|crushed]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. After [[Travia Chan]] merged the [[Fest Resistance Group]] with the survivors of the Liberators to form the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]] that later became the [[Atrivis Sector Force]] under the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Carplin served as Chan's [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]]. Due to medical conditions that confined her to a [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|repulsorchair]], Carplin acted as Chan's eyes and ears, constantly traveling throughout the sector and even taking charge of critical missions. Carplin was assisted by [[Busurra]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]; Busurra acted in Carplin's stead when the latter was off base on a mission.<ref name="RASB" />

==Personality and traits==
Big and strong with long mutton chops, Carplin was a warrior first and foremost. He often took charge of difficult operations undertaken by the Atrivis Sector Force.<ref name="RASB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Carplin was skilled in the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and blaster [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. He was also adept at [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]], and the deployment of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. Physically fit, Carplin was a strong swimmer, and trained in stealth and survival techniques. His experience as Chief of Staff gave him a working knowledge of the operation of a [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]], as well as knowledge about [[Alien/Legends|alien]] languages and planetary [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Carplin also knew how to contact the criminal underworld if needed. His mechanical and technical proficiencies included being able to drive [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, operate demolitions equipment, apply first aid, and bypass security systems.<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Equipment==
Carplin was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="RASB2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loom Carplin was created for the ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The later novel ''[[The Last Command]]'' mentioned that the Rebels managed to "sneak Travia Chan and her people out from under the Imperials' collective snout." This likely included both Carplin and Busurra.
